mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% over two consecutive months signals improving manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index above 3% over two consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which increases the probability of aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month over three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 200000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,400,000 units over two consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related equities and overall economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1400000 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
